notes.title: New Trailer & Demo Out Now
notes.notes:
[h1]Brand-New Trailer and... DEMO![/h1]

Today at the [b]Future Games Show[/b], we revealed the latest trailer for [b]Terrifier: The Art-Cade Game[/b], and we couldn’t be prouder (or bloodier). Get ready for new levels, even more grotesque enemies, ridiculously brutal weapons, and tons of classic horror movie references.

[previewyoutube=In0ChuU40Gk;full][/previewyoutube]

The video showcases new film-set-inspired stages straight out of Art’s twisted cinematic universe, all with gloriously bloody pixel art, local multiplayer modes, power-ups, and a full-blown retro arcade spirit.

And if you haven’t played it yet…

[b]The demo is now available on Steam[/b]. Time to start punching your way through this insanely fun, blood-soaked adventure starring everyone's favorite homicidal clown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248614/92b616db7acfec7477093245d248cf5f5326c4cf.gif[/img]

[b]Terrifier: The Art-Cade Game[/b] is a side-scrolling gore beat 'em up packed with fast-paced action, dark humor, and that sweet, sweet '80s nostalgia. Expect brutal animations, twisted bosses, and gameplay designed to deliver non-stop carnage.

Smash that demo, wishlist the game, and get ready to suffer (from laughter or fear—you decide)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130400/Terrifier_The_ARTcade_Game/

notes.title: New Screenshots Revealed for Screamfest 3!
notes.notes:
Hello Terrifier Fans!

In celebration of[u][b] Steam’s Screamfest 3[/b][/u] this Halloween 2024, we’re thrilled to reveal two new in-game screenshots from [i][b]Terrifier: The ARTcade Game![/b][/i] These captures offer a sneak peek into some of the latest updates we’ve been crafting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248614/7cb6e035681b08069d3ecaecef9070c7f79ac584.png[/img]
[i]Screenshot 1[/i]
In this shot, Art faces off against a mix of enemies on a chaotic movie set. Each level will culminate in a challenging boss fight, adding variety and testing players’ skills as they progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248614/718b2aafda2daadcdc18d0a1c4806fc2e90c6386.png[/img]
[i]Screenshot 2[/i]
Here, Art uses finishers and weapons to deliver brutal attacks. The game emphasizes creative combat, allowing players to combine weapon use with unique finishers for maximum carnage.

Since our last update, we’ve been focused on core gameplay improvements, like expanding Art’s moveset, optimizing enemy AI, and adding new weapon types for even more gruesome attacks. The game is still in early development, and every bit of fan feedback has been crucial in guiding our progress.

[h3]Thank you for joining us in the journey to bring Terrifier: The ARTcade Game to life! Stay tuned for more updates, and be sure to add the game to your wishlist on [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012787]PS5[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130400/Terrifier_The_ARTcade_Game/]Steam[/url] to stay on top of the latest news.
[/h3]

Happy Halloween, and enjoy Screamfest 3!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130400/Terrifier_The_ARTcade_Game/

notes.title: Thank You for Your Enthusiasm!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248614/2a8a4137d31eeac1d8b37a16f5ac3bb51229b0d0.gif[/img]

[h2]Hello Terrifier Fans,[/h2]

We are incredibly grateful for the overwhelming excitement and support you’ve shown for [i]Terrifier: The ARTcade Game![/i] Your enthusiasm is what drives us to make this game the best it can be, and we are excited to see the community coming together to celebrate the upcoming release.

Recently, we noticed that a few screenshots from the test prototype phase were accidentally published. We want to clarify that these early images do not reflect the current state of the game. The development team has been working tirelessly to improve and refine the game, ensuring it captures the essence of the Terrifier franchise while delivering a fun and gory retro beat 'em up experience.

[h2]Early Development Progress[/h2]

We are still in the early stages of development, but rest assured, we have some exciting updates and features in the works that we can’t wait to share with you. Your patience and support mean the world to us as we continue to polish and perfect every aspect of the game.

[h2]Sneak Peek: Updated Screenshots[/h2]

To give you a glimpse of our progress, we are excited to share four updated screenshots from the game that we already updated on Steam store page. Please note that these images represent an early stage of development and we are continuously working to enhance the game’s visuals and gameplay. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45248614/81434d933d7cd13121b6585911c88d6a2215de4e.jpg[/img]

[h2]Stay Tuned for More News[/h2]

We promise to keep you updated with all the latest news and developments. There’s a lot more to come, and we are eager to share our journey with you. Make sure to follow our Steam page and stay connected for more sneak peeks, announcements, and behind-the-scenes content.

[b][h3]Don`t Forget to add Terrifier To your wishlist on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3130400/Terrifier_The_ARTcade_Game/]Steam[/url] And [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012787]PS5[/url].[/h3][/b]
Thank you once again for your incredible support. Together, we’re creating something truly special!

Stay spooky, The Terrifier: The ARTcade Game Publishing & Development Team.
